payload.claim: test_changing_only_claude_md_at_base_changes_both_digests is the witness for the acceptance criterion that changing only CLAUDE.md at base changes both the CLAUDE.md digest and the request digests in events.jsonl, but its `_run` helper only ever extracts `Agent` (request) digests from the read-back log; it never reads back the `Preflight` event with step `claude_md` and never asserts anything about its detail. So this specific test cannot tell a `_preflight("claude_md", ...)` call that always logs a fixed/wrong digest from one that logs the real base-commit digest. Making the source always emit `hashlib.sha256(b"").hexdigest()` for the claude_md preflight fact (regardless of the actual base text) leaves this test green while defeating exactly the property its docstring and the acceptance criterion describe.
